title: 第23章 李二拐也抓
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 王秀菊听说，自己儿子又绑着赵丁去了大队，眼前就是一黑。徐喜弟才借了五十块钱走，就又跟着绑赵丁去了。张家都不让管，他还非要上赶子去多管闲事。刘德怀眼皮也一直跳个不停，两口子匆匆出门，刚走到半路，就听见大队放广播。“开会了！开会了！”王秀菊两腿差点就软了。儿子第二次绑赵丁，私下的恩怨也就算了，这是摆到明面来，让全村人去看。要命！他明天倒是去镇上报到上班，可他们老两口还住在村里啊！得罪姓赵的老无赖，后患无穷啊！……大队的办公室，就设在村中央，专门平了一块场地，开大会或者放放电影的时候用。广播喇叭一叫唤，没多久，广场就乌泱泱全是人。大家看到赵丁被绑在广播柱上，都很纳闷。‘赵丁又骗巴儿姐钻牛棚了？’‘不知道啊！’‘这几天，徐喜弟天天盯着巴儿姐呢，不可能！’‘难道是嫌钱少？’‘五十还少？’人群中嗡嗡嗡论成一片。“孩他妈，你怎么让人绑这儿了？”李祝英看到自己媳妇，被绑着手缩在一边，于是叫了一声。这一声不要紧，众人的目光全被吸引了过来。李家婶子衣服扣得有些乱，两手被绑着。她抬着手臂，努力把自己的脸遮挡起来。可是她还是被自家男人给认出来了。想到这，她慌乱地往地上一跪，“老头子，你听我解释，我真的是被迫的，他们都不信我。”徐喜弟往黑压压的人群中寻找，张国海和范金花也不知道是没来呢，还是来了看到她和刘宇宁绑了赵丁，又偷溜回家了。不在更好，他们不在，等下她就直接代表了张家的态度！“你说谁？谁强迫你？”李祝英压低了声，着急凑上去，就想给他媳妇解绳子。但是众人的雪亮目光，怎么可能放过他们。‘原来是赵丁和李家婶子啊？’‘这两人什么时候勾搭上的？’‘那是你们不知道，我撞见好几回了……’啧啧啧~众人议论纷纷，众说纷纭。李婶脸色都白了，跪在地上哐哐磕头，“我发誓，我真的是被逼的。”大队长也姓李，和李祝英算本家，一个族谱里的旁支兄弟。看到李婶这样，让全村人看热闹，脸上也不太好看。可他是大队长，必须公开公正。“好了，大家都安静！”他抬手，做了一个安静的手势，“赵丁的事，做了个坏榜样，如果按从前的规矩，耍流氓就得先批斗。”“但是今天召集大家来，是针对这个坏榜样，给大家做一次深刻的普法教育。”李队长拿出一个小本本，念了一通后，大伙安静地听了一些条条框框，模模糊糊，云里雾里。但最后的那句，总归有文化没文化的人，都听得明白。“赵丁这个事，得送公安，等下就安排两个人，马上把人送到镇上的公安局去。”“等等！”徐喜弟突然举起手，站了出来。“大队长，还有一个人，也要送公安！”谁还要送公安？大伙齐齐看向她，一个小丫头片子，张家都没个大人来，她一个外姓人在这里叫什么叫。李队长的眉头皱了皱，群众当着全村的面提出来，他就必须得听听看。“谁？干什么了？”“李二拐！我举报他！我家巴儿姐，心智不全，不能分辨是非对错，他用糖果，把人骗到上山，让我给当场抓住了！”“我去割猪菜，看到他在草丛里，压着我家巴儿姐，衣服都不穿。我一气之下，用棍子尖尖给他花屁股戳了两个洞。”“大家可以扒他裤子看看，是不是这回事。”李二拐站在人群最外面，本来是想看热闹的，一听到徐喜弟提他，吓得转身就想逃。赵丁给绑了两回，他确实好奇想过来看看，没想到这个小丫头，还把自己也给举报了。“李二拐，你干啥去？”李队长隔着人群，就精准找到了他的身影。李是村里的大姓，最没用又最无赖的，还属李二拐。李二拐知道自己跑不掉，只能转身，狗腿地陪着笑，“叔，她，她冤枉我！我根本就没得手！是赵丁……”“赵丁他骗了巴儿姐很多次，我可以作证，我就撞了不下四五次。我做证人，能不能申请宽大处理？”“衣服都脱完了，你说没得手就没得手？”徐喜弟不容他狡辩，今天必须连李二拐一起收拾了。与其天天这样，分秒盯着巴儿姐，不如杀两只鸡儆个猴。“要不是我手里拿着棍子，你当时还想打我！”“可怜巴儿姐，从小就残疾，见她好骗，你们人都不做了，做畜生！”“这样的畜生，我撞见一个是一个，必须送公安，公安会给我们张家一个满意的交代！”这话，既说给赵丁和李二拐听，也说给全村那些曾经对巴儿姐下过手的，或者准备下手的人听。“喜弟，你公婆今天都没来，这事他们知道吗？”李队长舔了舔嘴角。家中有长辈的，这种大事只能长辈发话。“队长，今天的大会，张家我做主。”徐喜弟态度斩钉截铁。“你，去，把李二拐也给我绑了。”李队长看李二拐被徐喜弟说得毫无狡辩之力，不用猜，也知道真有其事了。人群中，有人把裤腰带一抽，上去就捆李二拐的手。“徐喜弟，你给我等着，等我回来，看我怎么收拾你！”李二拐被拿，转头恶狠狠对上徐喜弟。徐喜弟冷哼一声。“哼，现在不装了？当着全村人的面威胁我！我就等你回来！我能戳你两个洞，就能再戳你四个八个！”所有人一听，都很诧异。张家捡回来的这个小丫头，还挺硬气！甚至还有人暗暗竖起大拇指。张家有一个这样的媳妇，将来说不定也能立起来。谁也没发现，徐喜弟手心里已经全是汗，甚至有点抖。跟恶人斗，只能豁出脸去，放狠话，谁不会？至于等李二拐回来？她又不傻，等怀了孩子，生下来，她就走得远远的。让李二拐上天涯海角找她去！
content_en: When Wang Xiuju heard that her son had tied up Zhao Ding and went to the brigade again, everything went dark before her eyes.Xu Xidi just borrowed 50 yuan and left, and then went to kidnap Zhao Ding again.The Zhang family didn't let him interfere, but he still insisted on going to the house to meddle in other people's business.Liu Dehuai's eyelids kept twitching as the couple hurried out. As soon as they were halfway there, they heard the radio broadcast from the brigade."It's a meeting! It's a meeting!" Wang Xiuju's legs almost gave out.When the son kidnapped Zhao Ding for the second time, the private grudges were forgotten. This was put out in the open for the whole village to see.It's terrible!He will go to town to report for work tomorrow, but the old couple still live in the village!If you offend the old scoundrel named Zhao, there will be endless troubles!...The brigade's office is located in the center of the village, with a dedicated area for holding meetings or showing movies.The loudspeaker shouted, and soon the square was filled with people.Everyone was puzzled when they saw Zhao Ding tied to the broadcasting pole.‘Zhao Ding tricked Sister Ba’er into going to the bullpen again?’ ‘I don’t know!''These days, Xu Xidi has been staring at Sister Ba'er every day. It's impossible!’ ‘Is it because you don’t have enough money?’ ‘Fifty is still less?’ The crowd was buzzing with discussion."Damn it, why did you let someone tie you up here?" Li Zhuying shouted when he saw his wife huddled aside with her hands tied.It didn't matter. Everyone's attention was attracted by this sound.Aunt Li's clothes were buttoned a bit messily, and her hands were tied.She raised her arms and tried to hide her face.But she was still recognized by her man.Thinking of this, she knelt down in panic and said, "Old man, listen to my explanation. I was really forced. They don't believe me." Xu Xidi looked among the dark crowd. Zhang Guohai and Fan Jinhua didn't know whether they were not here or whether they were here. They saw her and Liu Yuning kidnapping Zhao Ding and sneaking home again.It's better not to be away. If they aren't here, she will directly represent the Zhang family's attitude later!"Who are you talking about? Who forced you?" Li Zhuying lowered his voice and rushed forward anxiously, wanting to untie his wife's rope.But with the sharp eyes of everyone, how could they let them go.‘So it’s Zhao Ding and Aunt Li’s family?’ ‘When did these two people hook up?’ ‘That’s because you don’t know, I’ve bumped into him several times...’ Tsk tsk tsk~ Everyone was talking about it and had different opinions.Aunt Li's face turned pale, and she knelt on the ground and kowtowed, "I swear, I was really forced." The captain's surname was also Li, and he and Li Zhuying were brothers in the same family tree.Seeing Aunt Li like this, the whole village was watching the fun, and her face didn't look good.But he is the captain and must be open and fair."Okay, everyone, be quiet!" He raised his hand and made a quiet gesture, "Zhao Ding's incident has set a bad example. If we follow the previous rules, hooligans must be criticized first." "But we are summoned today to deal with this bad example and give everyone a profound legal education." Captain Li took out a small book and read it for a while. Everyone listened to some rules quietly, vaguely and in the fog.But the last sentence can be understood by people with or without culture."Zhao Ding's matter has to be sent to the police. We will arrange for two people to send him to the public security bureau in the town immediately." "Wait!" Xu Xidi suddenly raised his hand and stood up."Captain, there is another person who also wants to be sent to the police!" Who wants to be sent to the police?Everyone looked at her. She was a little girl. No adults from the Zhang family were here. What did she call someone with a foreign surname here?Captain Li frowned. The masses raised it in front of the whole village, so he had to listen."Who? What did he do?" "Li Erguai! I'll report him! My sister Ba'er is mentally retarded and can't tell right from wrong. He used candy to trick people into going up the mountain, and I caught him on the spot!" "I went to cut pig vegetables and saw him in the grass, pressing down on my sister Ba'er.He didn't even have any clothes on.I was so angry that I poked two holes in his butt with the tip of the stick."You can take off his pants to see if this is the case."Li Erguai stood at the outside of the crowd, originally wanting to watch the fun, but when he heard Xu Xidi mentioning him, he turned around and wanted to run away.Zhao Ding was kidnapped twice. He was really curious and wanted to come over and have a look. Unexpectedly, this little girl also reported him."Li Erguai, what are you doing?" Captain Li found his figure accurately across the crowd.Li is the most popular surname in the village, and the most useless and scoundrel one is Li Erguai.Li Erguai knew he couldn't run away, so he could only turn around and laugh along with him, "Uncle, she, she wronged me! I didn't succeed at all! It was Zhao Ding..." "Zhao Ding has lied to Sister Ba'er many times. I can testify that II bumped into him no more than four or five times.I'm a witness. Can I apply for leniency?"I've already taken off my clothes. If you say you didn't succeed, you didn't succeed."Xu Xidi didn't allow him to quibble, and he had to deal with Li Erguai today.Instead of staring at Sister Ba'er like this every day, it's better to kill two chickens to scare the monkey."If I hadn't held a stick in my hand, you still wanted to hit me!" "Poor sister Ba'er, she has been disabled since she was a child. Seeing that she is easy to deceive, all of you will stop doing it and become a beast!" "I encounter such beasts one after another. They must be sent to the police. The police will give our Zhang family a satisfactory explanation!" These words were told not only to Zhao Ding and Li Erguai, but also to those in the village who had done something to Sister Ba'er before, or were planning to do something."Brother happy, your parents-in-law didn't come today. Do they know about this?" Captain Li licked the corner of his mouth.If there are elders in the family, only the elders can have the say on such important matters."Captain, I will make the decision for the Zhang family in today's meeting." Xu Xidi's attitude was resolute."You, go and tie up Li Erguai for me too." Captain Li saw that Li Erguai was speechless by Xu Xidi and knew that it was true without guessing.In the crowd, someone pulled up his belt and tied Li Erguai's hands."Xu Xidi, just wait for me. When I come back, see how I deal with you!" Li Erguai was taken away and turned to face Xu Xidi fiercely.Xu Xidi snorted coldly."Huh, don't pretend now? Threaten me in front of the whole village! I'll wait for you to come back! If I can poke you two holes, I can poke you four or eight more!" Everyone was surprised when they heard this.This little girl picked up by the Zhang family is quite tough!Some even gave a secret thumbs up.If the Zhang family has a daughter-in-law like this, she may be able to establish a family in the future.No one noticed that Xu Xidi's palms were already sweaty and even a little trembling.When fighting evil people, you can only show your face and speak cruelly, who wouldn't?As for waiting for Li Erguai to come back?She is not stupid. Once she is pregnant and gives birth to the child, she will go far away.Let Li Er go to the ends of the earth to find her!
